# WellyDesiBites

> WellyDesiBites is a home bakery in Johnsonville, Wellington, New Zealand, creating made-to-order eggless cakes, cupcakes and pastries for celebrations.

## Business details

- Brand: WellyDesiBites
- Location: Johnsonville, Wellington 6037, New Zealand
- Service area: Wellington region
- Hours: Daily, 10:00 am–8:00 pm
- Phone and WhatsApp: +64 21 083 26153
- Ordering: personalised quotes by WhatsApp or phone; cake price depends on flavour, design and size.

## What WellyDesiBites offers

- 100% eggless custom cakes for birthdays, anniversaries, baby showers, kids' celebrations and festive occasions
- Eggless cupcakes and pastries
- Vegan and gluten-free options on request; customers should discuss dietary requirements before ordering
- Flavours including fruit, Desi-inspired, signature and tres leches options
- Collection in Johnsonville and delivery across the Wellington region for an additional charge
